description: Read alerts and what they said. Pass alertId for one alert: its query and condition, whether it is on or snoozed, what its last check read per series, who hears it and what it said recently. issueId gives that issue's latest fix check (awaiting_release, watching, recurred, no_recurrence, not_enough_evidence or stopped, with exposure and recurrences on the fix release). Neither lists every alert in the project, what fired in the last 24 hours, and the saved channels an alert can post to.

issueId.description: The issue id (from list_issues) or its Vinktar URL, as a person would paste it.

project.description: Project handle (as in list_projects) or id. Optional when this connection is limited to one project or the workspace has only one.
